title: Handle complex nonfinite results deliberately
goal: Distinguish undefined results from directed infinities and preserve signed-zero expectations when upgrading a double-based complex signal pipeline.

Route finite, infinite and undefined results separately before consuming a signal measurement.
constraints: Actual paired nongeneric Complex arithmetic, named multiply/divide, zero divisors, reciprocal/magnitude/power, elementary/trigonometric/hyperbolic/inverse cases, component bits and signed-zero controls; finite controls and application classification. Exact SDK/reference/runtime identities and inputs/results recorded. Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT; no other engine/platform or GA proof.

Infinity takes precedence over companion NaN in the classification policy; a companion NaN still has no usable direction. A zero quotient component has no universal sign promise. Reciprocal(Zero) is observed as Zero on both artifacts.
No generic-storage migration, package, provider, rendering mode, native toolchain, workload or experimental opt-in is required. The net10 comparison adds no foundation edition.
